provenance.rights: Research/academic use; retain repository license notice, URL and citations.
citations: Jiang et al., A Large-scale Evaluation for Log Parsing Techniques: How Far are We?, ISSTA 2024
Zhu et al., Loghub: A Large Collection of System Log Datasets for AI-driven Log Analytics, ISSRE 2023
provenance.scope: Real 2k sample, distinct from the Zenodo full HDFS corpus

contract.delimiter: LF byte only; delimiter excluded from value; CR retained
contract.blank_lines: one empty string per LF-delimited blank record
contract.final_newline: terminal LF terminates the last record; no phantom extra row
contract.preprocessing: none; BOM, NUL, whitespace, Unicode forms and order preserved

representation: separate nonnegative int32 ID/offset leaves; little endian
